attempt_1.mechanism: num_predict bound the response. The context window still had 753 tokens free.

attempt_2.why: 3072 is above the 2801 tokens the 18432 context can still hold after a 15631-token prompt, so a length stop at about 2801 tokens is the context remainder and a length stop at 3072 would mean the server loaded a larger context. A natural stop before either cap completes the request path.
